question:
In the given figure, what is the value (in degrees) of (x + y + z) ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f38178f4c5ee5f2f08a025a10d8e4cdb4a7f1310e3053838e30ca456e28638.png]
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ In a concave quadrilateral (arrowhead or boomerang shape), the angle at the interior concave vertex is equal to the sum of the three interior opposite angles. Property: Interior Angle at the dent = x + y + z From the figure, the angle at the concave vertex is given as 140°. ∴ x + y + z = 140° **∴ The correct answer is 140°.**
